name: Holy Star of Mystra

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: A star of Mystra's power blazes over you: you have Three-Quarters Cover and shed Bright Light 5 feet and Dim Light 5 feet beyond. When you cast it and as a Bonus Action later, you make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 120 feet for 4d10 + your spellcasting modifier Force or Radiant damage (chosen when cast). After you succeed on a save against a spell of level 7 or lower that targets only you and has no area, you can use your Reaction to turn it back on its caster, who saves against their own spell (set it to Automatic in the class tab).
